result:
I created `docs/policies/tls-verification.md`. It says TLS certificate verification stays on for all builds, development included, with no dev-only exception. It also notes that this fits the separate decision to enforce https everywhere with no plaintext exception for any service.

The statement comes from the project's recorded decisions (#31, and #34 for the https point). I left out the earlier "verification off in dev builds" idea, since decision #31 replaced it. I also left out the "plain http is fine for internal services" note, since #34 replaced that too.

Muninn's session-start heartbeat reported RED: 22 hook runs started and never finished. That may mean a hook is exceeding its timeout. It didn't affect the records I used, but it is worth checking `.muninn/log/heartbeat.jsonl`.
